summary: This room's five targets turned out to be much better wired than their low reached_by counts suggested — every hop1 neighbour of Agent Toolbox, Skills Are Enchantable Pages, The Palace Hardens Around Values, and The Practice Rediscovers Its Philosophy already carries a reciprocal link back (symmetric connects-to or the correct directional pair), so the low count is an artifact of how few of those neighbours are themselves well-reached, not a sign of isolation. The one real find is a hop2 bridge for The Palace Speaks: Skills Are Enchantable Pages names the same ceremony/specialist/skill/steward migration pattern from the tool-mechanics side that The Palace Speaks names from the mind/agency side, and the two never point at each other. The other genuine yield was inside a body, not the walk: The Practice Rediscovers Its Philosophy names Trickster Commit and LoRA Trainer as two of its five founding evidence pairs in plain prose, with no bracket around either — both are real entries, both belong in its frontmatter. Agent Toolbox stayed the clearest null: nothing in its hop1/hop2 ring (beyond what already links) mentions tool profiles, least-privilege, or the toolbox pattern, so it's a target whose reach will only grow when new entries about agent dispatch get written, not by forcing today's neighbours toward it.

typed_relations.label: migration-siblings
typed_relations.rationale: Both name the same shift — a palace organ moving from static canon/ceremony to a dispatched, addressable actor — from two different angles: Skills Are Enchantable Pages gives the trigger/executor mechanics (ceremony · specialist · skill · steward as one family), The Palace Speaks gives the mind/agency framing (library vs. actor, corpus you load vs. mind you address) with Concierge as the shared worked example in both. Neither's frontmatter points at the other.
typed_relations.evidence: Skills: 'Ceremony · specialist · skill · steward · enchanted page are one pattern — a page with a dispatch surface'; Palace Speaks: 'Its first working organ is the [[Concierge]]... the technical shape of the shift is library → actor.'
